oracle_basis.energy_source: DT_SkillDamageData ChargeAdd rows feed daffodil.ordinary_hit_energy_v1; the 3/5 CHAOS relation and exact per-recipient carry policy are specified in the owner/shared models. Final ledgers below are literal tested scenario expectations, not claims of native eligibility.

checks: Focused Rust owner test validates action timing, packet counts, segment damage, exact total/horizon DPS, and all three energy ledgers.
Focused authored NTE test compiles to a request and checks the same damage, timing, source/recipient energy, native report, and actual Worker parity.
limits: Synthetic stats, fixed noncritical damage, explicit capacities, and the 36-second schedule are runner inputs, not game measurements or an optimized rotation.

Caller timing, Normal-chain continuity, primary packet behavior, ordinary-hit positive-HP-loss eligibility, living recipient rules, exact fractional settlement, and the 3/5 team relation are bounded hypotheses pending native dispatch evidence.

The caller-supplied 120 Burst cost does not prove native action cost, affordability/readiness, or live timing. The fixture does not establish animation/cancel timing, natural Branch/Entry/AirAttack dispatch, Break behavior, additional targets, or unsupported Daffodil passives.
Damage totals and final energy ledgers are exact oracles for this named scenario; they do not imply full-kit coverage or strict-ready DPS.
